mentions.name: StageWatch
mentions.description: A simple order status tracker for small fabricators and craftsmen. Businesses define their process and instantiate it per customer order; the customer receives a link to a status page and can subscribe to status notifications. This saves time by preventing customers from calling to ask about their order status. Built as a vanilla Rails app running on a Hetzner VPS.
mentions.problem: Customers repeatedly call the business asking for the status of their order, wasting time.
mentions.audience: Small German fabricators and craftsmen running small businesses
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://stagewatch.de/

Basically a simple pizza status tracker for small German fabricators and craftsman. You define the process, instantiate it per customer order who receives the link to a status page with a possibility to subscribe to status notifications as well. The benefit is that people don't call you anymore asking for the status of their order, saving time.
